description: Armada PXA2128 is an application processor SoC (http://www.marvell.com/application-processors/armada/pxa2128/). It has a dedicated security hardware module, known as WTM, that runs secure firmware kernel to perform device trusted boot, access control, authentication, key management, DRM, disk encryption, and FIPS certified cryptographic operations.
